title: introduce-cost-onramp-starter-profiles-and-quant-snapshotter
author: Nina Vargas
release_notes: - Add 'redwood econ init' to create tenant starter profiles for batching, cache, and quantization; - Add 'redwood quant snapshot export' for creating deterministic quantization snapshots for safe rollouts; - Conservative non-breaking defaults that prioritize unit-econ and latency; - CLI dry-run and suggestions output for operator review;
description: Summary: This PR adds a small, opinionated 'onramp' for tenant cost-optimization: a CLI-driven starter profile generator plus a lightweight quant-snapshot exporter service. Motivation: many customers ask for safe, quick wins to reduce per-token cost without manual tuning. This delivers curated batching, cache and quantization starter profiles that are conservative by default and a deterministic snapshot export to enable safe quant rollouts. Changes: 1) CLI: 'redwood econ init --tenant <id> [--dry-run]' generates YAML starter profiles (batch_size, batching_strategy, cache_prefixes, quant_profile_hint) and outputs a suggested rollout plan; 2) Service: quant-snapshot-exporter: reads a tenant's model bundle and produces a reproducible quant snapshot (metadata + sample validation traces) to be used by the model-ops workflow for canarying; 3) Runtime defaults: introduces 'starter-econ' default profile that is selected only for new tenants or when admins explicitly opt-in; this avoids surprise regressions for existing tenants; 4) Unit-econ estimator: a new lightweight estimator that simulates per-token cost/latency given traffic shape and profiles and produces a simple CSV summary to help SRE/product decide; 5) Docs + examples: quickstart and migration notes. Testing: added unit tests for the estimator and snapshot exporter; integration test validates that 'econ init --dry-run' produces valid profiles without changing tenant config; CI: initial lint failure (eslint on CLI) fixed in second commit, full CI now green. Rollout plan: merge to main, feature flag the exporter behind runtime flag 'econ.quant_snapshotter.v1' and enable for internal beta tenants for 2 weeks before tenant-facing release. Migration notes: non-breaking by default; admins can opt-in tenants via the console or CLI. Security/Privacy: exporter only runs on model bundles that are customer-approved and writes snapshots to encrypted artifact storage (KMS). Related: ENG-3245 implements the linear tracking item for this onramp; SUP-4567 describes a customer request that triggered this work. Checklist: [x] CLI implemented; [x] unit tests; [x] integration tests for dry-run; [x] docs updated; [x] feature-flagged rollout; [x] security review notes added;
